name: Datteln (Germany)
description: Horizontal stripes of black and white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Datteln (a black cross and a ring on white).
history: Municipal flag of Datteln; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Datteln arms — cross and ring on white
